entries.name: Dang.ai
entries.evidence: Live pricing page: Basic is $49. Button text is Get listed for $49 (skip the backlink, review in about 4 days, Featured badge). The same page also shows a $0 plan and Pro at $30 setup then $19/mo. Noted in the Oct 15 2026 research log as a $49 faster review.

entries.name: Toolify
entries.evidence: The submit page still offers a paid permanent listing (in the list and Just Launched within 48 hours, no queue, border highlight, dofollow links). A raw fetch on 2026-11-05 was blocked by Cloudflare (403), and the fetched FAQ left the price answer collapsed, so this dollar amount is not marked in the range. The last quote of their own FAQ (checked 2026-10-18) is: It costs $99 to list a tool. This is a one-time payment. $99 sits inside $49–$437. Oct 15 2026 research log also recorded $99.
